mostWorthwhile.text: Binding the assembled studies into the encyclopedia gave the chapter a clear payoff.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the studies one at a time became repetitive and predictable.

surprise.text: Thread and planks made a loom rather than the binding component I expected; its role remained unclear.

arbitrary.text: The loom felt disconnected from the encyclopedia goal, and its purpose was not explained during this chapter.

continue.text: I would probably stop here: the finished encyclopedia is a satisfying endpoint, but the repeated fittings offered few meaningful decisions.
